# GitHub Copilot Repository Instructions

Follow `AGENTS.md` and `.ai/conventions.md` for requests that may change software code, behavior, tests, technical configuration, schemas, dependencies, build/deployment mechanics, or CC Flow itself. Read the project, profile, architecture, business, and progress files under `.ai/` before proposing non-trivial changes.

For read-only questions, explanations, exploration, research, reports, summaries, status checks, or standalone document creation, do not create or update CC Flow records unless explicitly requested.

For non-simple tasks, use the corresponding `.ai/tasks/<task>/` directory and complete its plan, result, and review records. Keep changes scoped, preserve compatibility unless the task explicitly changes it, run the repository's real checks, and update affected documentation.
